Messages.Author: Martin Bruset Solberg
Messages.Body:
I'm wondering how a combat where one of the vampires have first strike is
played.

I have a vampire in combat with another vampire, and my vampire has first
strike. We are at long range and I play a Taste of Blood.

If he plays a combat ends, what happens?

If he plays a dodge, what happens?

If he plays a strike, what happens?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Martin Bruset Solberg wrote:
>
> I'm wondering how a combat where one of the vampires have first strike is
> played.
>
> I have a vampire in combat with another vampire, and my vampire has first
> strike. We are at long range and I play a Taste of Blood.
>
> If he plays a combat ends, what happens?

Combat ends. [6.4.5]

> If he plays a dodge, what happens?

He avoids the effects of your strike [6.4.5]

> If he plays a strike, what happens?

After resolving your strike, if both of you are still ready, his
strike resolves. [6.4.5]
